name: flute
description: v8: wooden recorder-style flute standing perpendicular to the wall (axis along local +Y). Cream bell toward the camera, cream foot at the wall, ivory rings and finger holes. The marble hits the tube body; a shallow flattened facet keeps the contact plane at z=+0.045 with +Z normal. No separate board, no side pins.

contact.note: marble centre at hit = point + normal*R
